summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing EU approval of Etcamah (camizestrant) in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor for first-line advanced ER-positive breast cancer. The approval is based on SERENA-6 Phase III trial results. This is a regulatory product approval announcement, not a special situation event. No corporate transaction, activist campaign, or structural change is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of a product milestone by a pharmaceutical issuer.
